notes: Added PDO role with 3-step registration flow: PDO, President, Member.
Manage Members and Google Drive Backup are now restricted to PDO users only.
User role is now displayed on the profile screen.
Backup screen now shows a warning when Google sign-in expires.
President and Members see a backup status warning on the Settings screen.
PDO can access Google Drive Backup directly without PIN verification.
Safe role replacement: changing a member to President now prompts to replace the current President and uses a transaction to prevent database errors.
PDO can now restore from Google Drive or set up backup during initial registration.
